title: Call behavior is independent of memory-choice replacement
statement: Let $A$ assign to each label either a deterministic instruction or a memory instruction, and let $l_0\in\Lambda$ and $\beta,\beta'\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. The compiled register programs obtained by retaining deterministic instructions and replacing every memory instruction with the corresponding return of $\beta$ and of $\beta'$ have identical call maps.
